sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Very impatient, cross, and irritable. Fron-
tal headache, with enlarged feeling of eyes. Face
urinklcd and old-looking.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text: Metallic taste. Sensation of a thread in

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Breath and taste foul. Intense nausea,
with vomiting, purging, and faintness. Stool very of-
fensive. Abdomen bloated.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Scanty with frequent urging, with pressure
on bladder and burning in urethra. Flow .stops sud-
denly followed by pain. Urine toul. Cannot retain
urine; must attend to the call without delay. Irritable
bladder before menses.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menses delayed. Increased flow of saliva

during. Intense burning in vagina. Leucorrhcea, pro-

[Oxal. ac.]

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Aches, weak; drawing of muscles below
scapulaea.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Feels a glow^ all over, like being over
steam ; chilly, while sitting beside the fire.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Prickly itching. Sore spots all over. Skin
emits foul odor.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Better, sitting or lying down. Worse,
left side ; moving about.
